statement: let roots := fun a q : ℕ => (Finset.range q).filter (fun r => q ∣ r^2+a); ∀ q : ℕ, 0<q → Squarefree q → (roots 1 q).card = ∏ p ∈ q.primeFactors, (if p=2 then 1 else if p%4=1 then 2 else 0)
